lastCompletedStory.title: Add the naming-decision section to docs/positioning.md

nextStoryContext: docs/positioning.md now has all four sections required by CAM-0415: (1) category definition, (2) unique-position thesis, (3) competitive landscape, and (4) naming decision (new in this story). Section 4 covers: 4.1 the five-round process narrative (GAMBREL was the four-round battery winner per the Downloads source docs, explicitly superseded here on the name: the final decision is GARBOARD, closed 2026-07-25); 4.2 kill evidence for Slipway, Ingot, Crivo, Assay, and the demoted champion Gambrel (org tombstoned, roof/butchery-dominated SERP, sonority rejected); 4.3 the 2026-07-25 live-measured round's dead -board family (freeboard, switchboard, gateboard, aboveboard, pegboard, larboard) and dead riffs (tenet, tenant, nova, fide); 4.4 dated namespace facts (gambrel org tombstoned, garboard bare user squatted by a dormant 2016 account, garboard-run org free via API but lockable only via the creation form, npm garboard free, all as of 2026-07-25); 4.5 alias policy (garboard canonical, gar the single typed alias, garb and gbd rejected, cam demoted to undocumented legacy symlink) cross-referencing ADR 0049 as the policy of record; 4.6 ranked reserves (Gateship #1, Puncheon, Laudo, Chancela, Gambrel demoted to reserve). All 12 acceptance-criteria oracles for US-003 were run locally against the edited file before commit (grep conjunctions for AC1-6, no-em-dash and no-emoji sweeps for AC8-9, typecheck/test/check:all for AC10-12) and pass; AC7 is reviewer-judgment (narrative quality). This closes the CAM-0415 epic's docs/positioning.md scope (US-002 landed sections 1-3, this story lands section 4); if this PRD has no further stories, README.md (CAM-331) and any operator namespace-locking ceremonies (garboard-run org, npm publish, domains) remain explicitly out of scope for this cycle per the epic's docs-only framing. No em dash, no decorative emoji introduced; both swept clean on the full file (all four sections) via grep and a perl emoji-range sweep, not just the new section.
